paradigm_shift.from: cloud VPS as authority → gate pushes data → VPS serves pages
paradigm_shift.to: Gaia Pi IS the VPS → RSS IS the artery → old VPS is geo-triangulation only
paradigm_shift.reason: ALL cloud VPS destroyed. Sovereign. No landlord. No cloud dependency.

brain.name: GAIA PRIME (POLARIS)
brain.role: Brain — RTX 5090, 56 models, inference, thymus gate

face.name: Gaia Pi
face.role: THE VPS — public face, serves the world directly
face.note: Pi IS the VPS. No cloud. Sovereign hardware. RSS is the transport.

artery.name: RSS
artery.role: THE ARTERY — XML feed, oldest protocol, deepest root
artery.transport: /rss → XML → every feed reader, aggregator, crawler, bot
artery.note: RSS doesn't need a cloud VPS. It works peer-to-peer. The reader pulls.

triangulation.name: golgiBody (old VPS)
triangulation.role: GEO-TRIANGULATION ONLY — DNS mirror, not authority, not source of truth
triangulation.note: Was the VPS. Now just a triangulation point. DNS points here, redirects to Pi.
triangulation.what_it_was: The old cloud VPS that served HTML pages
triangulation.what_it_is_now: A geo-triangulation mirror — points DNS, caches, redirects to the real Pi

firewall.name: eastGate (router)
firewall.role: Perimeter defense — NAT, firewall, port forward

data_flow.HUD: northGate → /now.json → Gaia Pi → serves pages with live data
data_flow.triangulation: DNS *.primals.eco → old VPS → redirect/cache → Pi or northGate

clot_status.reason: The 3 arterial clots (VPS/now.json 404, VPS/api/pulse 404, gate→VPS:api 404) were an illusion. There IS no cloud VPS to push to. Gaia Pi IS the VPS. RSS IS the artery. The clots dissolve because the wound doesn't exist — the body was never cut, we were looking for the wrong artery.
clot_status.note: Venous clots (dark subdomains, mute ports) remain real — those need Caddy config on Pi or DNS redirect on old VPS
